title: condense-json 1.0
why_it_matters: Simon Willison releases condense-json 1.0, a utility for compressing JSON payloads to save tokens when feeding data to LLMs. Practical tool for anyone piping structured data into context windows.
action: Try it on your LLM pipelines

title: Open letters about AI development
why_it_matters: Willison catalogues and critically examines the proliferating open letters about AI development, offering a tracker's perspective on which ones moved the needle and which were performative.
action: Read before signing the next one

title: Judge denies xAI's request to block Minnesota ban on 'nudify' apps
why_it_matters: A federal judge lets Minnesota's ban on AI nudification apps stand despite xAI's First Amendment challenge. Sets a precedent — state-level AI content regulation is surviving legal scrutiny, and other states are watching.
action: Track your state's pending AI legislation

title: Latest open artifacts (#23): Laguna S2.1, Inkling, & Kimi K3 show the utility of open models on the Pareto frontier
why_it_matters: Follow-up: Interconnects' Nathan Lambert maps how Laguna S2.1 reshapes the open-weight Pareto frontier alongside Inkling and Kimi K3. The real takeaway — the capacity to train competitive models is proliferating beyond the Big 3.
action: Compare the frontier chart to your model choices

title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is 'not healthy'
why_it_matters: Hank Green's public confession that LLM interaction gives him unhealthy dopamine hits is the most high-profile acknowledgment yet of AI dependency as a psychological pattern, not just a productivity discussion.

title: My personal AI benchmark: "Generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw."
why_it_matters: A fun but surprisingly revealing personal benchmark — asking models to generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw exposes differences in spatial reasoning, instruction-following, and creative interpretation across frontier models.
action: Try it as a quick model sanity check

title: AI poster wins Ohio State Fair contest
why_it_matters: An AI-generated poster wins the Ohio State Fair art contest, reigniting the debate about AI in creative competitions. After the 2022 Colorado incident, most expected rules would have caught up by now — they haven't.
action: Check competition rules before submitting AI-assisted work
